engagements.title: Gemini Enterprise for Automotive
engagements.format: Face-to-face, 2 days, in the MARii Digital Engineering and Prototyping (DEP) Generative AI Programme 2026. 20% concept, 30% guided demonstration, 50% hands-on.
engagements.audience: Participants from the Malaysian automotive industry in the MARii DEP Generative AI Programme 2026.
engagements.summary: Building grounded AI agents with enterprise data: a Gemini Enterprise session where automotive teams answered an EV adoption question with evidence they could trace and check.

journey.label: Audience
journey.detail: Automotive industry participants in MARii's DEP Generative AI Programme, after a morning of data analytics.

journey.label: Concept
journey.detail: From predictive models to grounded AI agents, and how a coordinator, a data agent and a knowledge agent divide the work.

journey.label: Hands-on
journey.detail: Half the session in Gemini Enterprise: prepared agents answering an EV adoption question from BigQuery data and four knowledge documents.

journey.label: Application
journey.detail: Classifying every claim as Supported, Inferred or Missing, with a harness checklist to carry into the AI ideation and MVP stages.
